max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return

nocolor.description: Disable ANSI color codes in output

print_filenames.description: Print only matching filenames, not line contents

dedupe.description: Amalgamate results for the same file in different packages

mode.description: Search mode: 'literal' (exact substring match) or 'regexp' (regular expression)

exclude.description: List of path fragments to exclude from results (e.g., ['vendor/', '.git/', 'test/'])
